input.sha256_scope: No image input. Every case is boxes and labels written out in the capture tool; the expected file is both the input record and the expected record.

upstream.capture_method: The pinned geometry helpers were imported and executed over synthetic box corpora covering every branch: the strict >3px overlap test, both membership polarities, the image-label drop exception, the touching-edge non-intersection, the int16 poly cast, and both the successful and degenerate paths of the recursive region shrinker.

limitations: Phase A of the orchestration slice: geometry only. The text-line machinery (group_boxes_into_lines, update_text_content), standardized_data's control flow, and the nested region ordering are later phases with their own captures.
Upstream iterates block-index sets in CPython set order; this port iterates ascending, which matches every recorded case and every reachable call site (the sets hold small consecutive integers).
shrink_supplement_region_bbox's stale-index re-read (position taken from the original distance list after removing from a copy) is preserved, not repaired.
No model is run and no page is decoded.
